unionAgreements.title: Authorizes the Supervisor to Enter into an Agreement with the CSEA- Merker
clauses: WHEREAS, William Merker has been employed with the Town since October 4, 2004 and has served in the position of Maintenance Mechanic III in the Street Lighting division of the Engineering department since January 1, 2019

WHEREAS, Town Engineer Ken Testa, requested a promotion for William Merker based on his qualifications and his tenure with the Town, and the Supervisor agreed. However, the Suffolk County Department of Civil Service is unable to grant the promotion from a Maintenance Mechanic III to a Maintenance Mechanic IV due to …

WHEREAS, the Civil Service Employees Association, Inc., Local 1000, AFSCME, AFL -CIO, Riverhead Unit of Suffolk Local #852 (CSEA) has agreed to a stipulation outlining a merit increase for Mr. Merker without a title promotion

RESOLVED, this Town Board hereby authorizes the Town Supervisor to enter into an agreement with the CSEA union to effectuate a merit increase in place of the promotion previously denied by Suffolk County Civil Service effective June 15, 2025 and sets William Merker’s salary at a rate of pay as found on Group 12, Step …

unionAgreements.title: Authorizes the Supervisor to Enter into an Agreement with the CSEA- Zebrowski
clauses: WHEREAS, Town Engineer Ken Testa has expressed his desire to give a merit increase to Building Maintenance Manager Dave Zebrowski and the Supervisor agreed

WHEREAS, giving Dave Zebrowski a merit increase from his current position of Group 20 step 16A on The CSEA Operational and Technical Salary Schedule would have pushed him to the end of the schedule, leaving no room for step increases for the duration of his tenure with the Town

WHEREAS, the Civil Service Employees Association, Inc., Local 1000, AFSCME, AFL - CIO, Riverhead Unit of Suffolk Local #852 (CSEA) has agreed to a stipulation outlining a merit increase for Mr. Zebrowski which will move him from the CSEA Operational and Technical Salary Schedule to the CSEA Administrative Salary …

RESOLVED, this Town Board hereby authorizes the Town Supervisor to enter into an agreement with the CSEA union effective June 15, 2025 and sets Dave Zebrowski’s salary at a rate of pay as found on Group 9, Step 6 of the CSEA Administrative Salary Schedule which is $94,266.94 per annum. .

unionAgreements.title: Authorizes Supervisor to Execute a Stipulation with Local 1000, AFSCME, AFL-CIO Riverhead Unit of the Suffolk Local 852
clauses: WHEREAS, Doris Strange has been an employee of the Town of Riverhead since September 13, 1993 serving in the title of Account Clerk in the Recreation department
WHEREAS, Ms. Strange is currently assigned to Group 9, Step 19 of the CSEA Clerical & Supervisory Salary Schedule which is $70,724.19 per annum

WHEREAS, in acknowledgement of Ms. Strange’s length of service, hard work and dedication, the CSEA and the Town Board have agreed on a one-time non- precedent setting basis to reassign Ms. Strange’s placement as an Account Clerk in the Recreation department within the structure of the aforementioned salary schedule …

RESOLVED, that the Town Board hereby approves the attached Stipulation between the Town of Riverhead and Local 1000, AFSCME, AFL-CIO, Riverhead Unit of Suffolk Local #852 the terms of which shall be deemed to be effective Monday, April 20, 2025 and authorizes the Town Supervisor to execute same with his signature.

unionAgreements.title: Authorizes the Supervisor to Execute a Stipulation with Local 1000, Afscme, AFL-CIO, Riverhead Unit of the Suffolk Local #852
clauses: WHEREAS, the Chief of Police has requested a promotion for a CSEA Union employee in a title that is not currently used by the Town of Riverhead, Public Safety Dispatcher III
WHEREAS, the CSEA Public Safety Dispatcher (PSD) salary schedule has group 1 for the title Public Safety Dispatcher I and group 2 for the title Public Safety Dispatcher II

WHEREAS, to accompany this title, the Town of Riverhead proposed to the CSEA that a new group, to be known as group 3, be added to the Public Safety Dispatcher (PSD) salary schedule for 2025 and forward to accommodate this new title, and the CSEA has subsequently agreed
RESOLVED, that the Town Board be and hereby approves the stipulation outlined in this resolution and authorizes the Supervisor to execute same
